name: Hatsune Miku
source:
The image of the virtual singer Vocaloid 2 developed by "YAHAHA" has a sweet voice and a lovely appearance matched with it. She is very popular on the Internet. After the protagonist installed the software, she mysteriously dropped out of the screen. Although there is a network of idols, it is also very difficult to wait.

 "Here, with minus seven chords, you have gone!"

[Rougly translated from [url=http://narratorsgame.blogspot.com/2012/03/17character.html]Official website[/url]]
